title: Story Retelling: Beginning, Middle & End
description: Retell stories in beginning, middle, and end through five picture-supported and read-aloud activities.
learningFocus: Retell familiar stories, including key details, in beginning, middle, and end with prompting and support (RL.K.2).
adultGuidance: Look at the pictures or read the short story together, then ask what happened at the beginning, middle, and end. Let your child retell it aloud in their own words; accept any telling that matches the events. If a part is missing, point to its picture and ask: What happens here?

seo.title: Story Retelling Worksheets for Kindergarten | Learning Made Simple
seo.description: Five free Kindergarten story-retelling worksheets for beginning, middle, and end, with picture support and a separate parent answer key.
